title: Spinning phone swaps sides with each line
summary: A phone spins in from the right and parks on the left beside a one-line statement, then turns once more and crosses to the right while a two-line claim wipes in on the left. Each line is wiped in the direction the phone travels.
use_when: A mobile site or app needs a 5 s teaser with two short lines and one hero screen
Silent social autoplay where one screenshot and two lines carry the message
A looping hero loop on a light landing page (starts and ends on blank white)
Setup line then benefit line, each paired with the same device

look.type_style: geometric sans, semibold, title case, normal tracking, cap height ~6 % H, black on white; line 2 is two centred lines

sfx.event: phone spins in from the right
a statement wipes in or out
phone turns and crosses to the other side

structure.shot: blank white, then a phone fades in at the right, spinning on its vertical axis while it travels left
structure.camera: locked-off: no camera move measured (motion.json pan 0, zoom 0 in 0-1 s)
structure.motion: phone opacity ~0.25 at 0.27 s to 1 at 0.50 s (fade ~8 fr, ±0.25 s); travel x 0.78 W -> 0.23 W from 0.27 s to 1.00 s (~22 fr, ~48 px/fr @1920), easings.outQuint (±0.25 s); spin back -> front -> back -> front across 0.27-1.00 s, >= 1 full turn (aliasing at 4 fps possible); height 0.44 H at 0.50 s -> 0.55 H at 1.00 s

structure.shot: phone with a shop page on the left in three-quarter view; statement 1 (3 words, sets the context) on the right half
structure.camera: locked-off: no camera move; the growth is the phone's own scale
structure.motion: statement 1 wipes in right-to-left with a soft-edged horizontal mask (edge follows the phone's leftward travel) while sliding ~3 % W left, done by 1.00 s (~7 fr, ±0.25 s); holds 1.00-1.50 s; phone settles at x 0.23 W, yaw ~20 deg showing the right edge, height 0.55 H -> 0.67 H (+22 % over 30 fr), springs.heavy (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: side swap: statement 1 wipes out, phone turns once and crosses to the right, statement 2 wipes in on the left
structure.camera: locked-off: motion.json 3.4 %/s zoom and 33 px/s pan in 2-3 s come from the phone's travel, not a camera
structure.motion: statement 1 hidden left-to-right by the mask edge, 1.77-2.10 s (~10 fr, ±0.25 s); phone front -> back (2.00) -> edge-on (2.27) -> front (2.50), one full turn in ~22 fr (±0.25 s); travel x 0.23 W -> 0.70 W, peak ~50 px/fr @1920 between 2.00 and 2.50 s; statement 2 (two lines) revealed left-to-right behind the passing phone, done by 2.50 s (~7 fr, ±0.25 s)

structure.shot: statement 2 (4 words, two centred lines, names the benefit) on the left, phone with the shop page on the right, front-facing
structure.camera: locked-off: statement 2 holds at x 0.32 W from 2.27 to 3.27 s
structure.motion: phone settles x 0.70 W -> 0.74 W by 2.77 s, easings.outQuint ~24 fr from 2.00 s (±0.25 s), height ~0.77 H, slight yaw ~10 deg; text holds 1.00 s

structure.shot: statement 2 wipes out, the phone leaves, blank white holds to the end (matches frame 0 for the loop)
structure.motion: statement 2 hidden left-to-right by the soft mask, gone by 3.77 s (~8 fr, ±0.25 s); phone present at 3.77 s, gone at 4.00 s (exit <= 7 fr, method not visible at 4 fps; near-miss scene score 9 at 4.00 s); white hold 30 fr

params.brand: any brand.json: display font and fg for the lines, bg for the field (light brands read closest to the reference)
params.content.lines: 2 statements: line 1 up to 4 words on one line (context), line 2 up to 6 words over two lines (benefit)
params.content.screen: one portrait screenshot of the product, shown on the phone for the whole film
params.aspect: 16:9 (phone and text share the frame halves); 9:16 would stack them, not measured
params.timing.swapAt: frame where the phone starts its crossing (default 53 at 30 fps)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: All timings from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s); no 30 fps strip was extracted. Spring and easing names are suggested defaults, overshoot not measurable. Spin direction and turn count during the entrance may be aliased at 4 fps. The reference is silent: every sfx is planned by the glue rule, not measured. No cuts in cuts.json: all rows are continuous. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): device-spin, side-swap, trailing-wipe. A rebuild without a 3D model can fake the spin with PhoneFrame tilt.y plus a back-plate face (missing component SpinPhone).
